label: Fake CBI/Police Threat
example_text: This is a final warning from CBI. Your Aadhaar is linked to a money laundering case. Call 9876543210 immediately or an arrest warrant will be issued.
explanation: Official authorities like the CBI or Police never threaten arrest over SMS or WhatsApp, nor do they demand immediate calls to personal mobile numbers.

label: Fake Customs/FedEx Alert
example_text: FedEx: Your parcel containing illegal items has been intercepted by customs. Press 1 to speak to our agent or legal action will be taken.
explanation: Couriers do not involve police over the phone for 'illegal items'. This is a common setup for a 'Digital Arrest' scam.

label: SBI KYC Expiry
example_text: Dear customer, your SBI YONO account will be blocked today due to pending KYC. Update immediately using this link: http://sbi-update-kyc.top
explanation: Banks never threaten to block your account on the same day via SMS with a non-official web link.

label: Electricity Disconnection
example_text: Dear Consumer, your electricity power will be disconnected tonight at 9:30 PM from the electricity office because your previous month bill was not updated. Please contact our electricity officer on 9123456789.
explanation: Utility companies send formal notices for overdue bills. They do not send SMS warnings to contact a random mobile number on the same night.

label: Receive Money QR
example_text: Please scan this QR code on PhonePe/GPay to receive your OLX advance payment of ₹5,000.
explanation: You NEVER have to scan a QR code or enter your UPI PIN to RECEIVE money. Doing so will debit money from your account.
